job.title: Cyber Security Lead
job.description:
Lead the team. Drive security outcomes. Shape what's next.
e2Cyber is exclusively partnering with a growing organisation in the Defence sector to find an experienced Cyber Security Lead who can bring strong technical and consulting capability, while leading and growing an established cyber team.
This is a genuine leadership opportunity for someone who enjoys being involved in both strategy and delivery. You'll lead a team of four cyber professionals, oversee a range of projects, and play a key role in expanding the organisation's cyber capability as demand continues to grow.
We're looking for someone who can confidently engage with stakeholders, provide trusted advice, and lead complex accreditation and assurance activities across Defence-related environments.

What You'll Be Doing
  • Leading and mentoring a team of cyber security professionals.
  • Overseeing the delivery of multiple cyber security projects and engagements.
  • Providing technical leadership across cyber initiatives.
  • Leading accreditation and assurance activities across networks, systems and applications.
  • Acting as a trusted advisor to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Contributing to the growth and development of the cyber practice.
  • Supporting both Defence and commercial cyber security initiatives.
What We're Looking For
You'll likely come from a consulting, advisory, GRC or security assurance background and will be comfortable operating across both technical and stakeholder-facing environments.
Experience in the following areas is highly desirable:
  • IRAP
  • ISMS
  • DSPF
  • ISO 27001
  • Essential Eight
  • Security Accreditation
  • Authority to Operate (ATO) processes
  • Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC)
  • Accreditation of networks, systems and applications
You'll also bring:
  • Defence industry experience (essential)
  • Experience working with DISP requirements
  • Consulting or client-facing experience
  • Strong stakeholder engagement skills
  • Experience leading teams and technical project delivery
  • Previous penetration testing or broader technical security experience would be advantageous
Why Consider This Role?
  • Lead an established cyber team with plans for significant growth.
  • Influence the direction of a developing cyber capability.
  • Work across a diverse range of Defence and security-focused projects.
  • Maintain a blend of leadership, consulting and hands-on cyber security work.
  • Flexible hybrid working arrangements.
  • Long-term career growth and progression opportunities.
Security Clearance To be considered, you must hold a current NV1 Security Clearance at a minimum. NV2 clearance is highly regarded.
If you're a senior cyber professional looking for a role where you can lead from the front, build capability, and have a genuine impact on a growing cyber practice, we'd love to hear from you.
Apply through e2Cyber today.
Please note that due to the volume of applications expected, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

job.title: Cloud Cyber Security Technical Writer
job.description:
Contract Opportunity – Federal Government | Canberra Based | NV1 Required

A Federal Government department is seeking an experienced IRAP Assessor to support a major uplift of technical and security documentation for a cloud platform preparing for an upcoming IRAP assessment. This role is ideal for someone who combines deep assurance expertise with exceptional technical writing capability.

About the Role You will lead the uplift of documentation across a complex cloud environment, working closely with technical SMEs to identify gaps, gather information, and refine artefacts to meet IRAP and ISM expectations. This includes moderating content for reusability, ensuring alignment with security frameworks, and supporting technical teams to articulate system design and configuration clearly and accurately.

Key Responsibilities
  • Review, uplift, and produce high quality technical and security documentation

  • Identify documentation gaps and work with SMEs to gather required information

  • Support preparation activities for an IRAP assessment

  • Moderate and structure content to ensure reusability and appropriate security handling

  • Provide guidance on technical remediation where required

  • Collaborate with infrastructure, application, and cloud teams to ensure accuracy and completeness of artefacts

Required Experience
  • IRAP certification

  • Minimum 5 years’ experience in Federal Government ICT environments

  • Strong background producing documentation such as:

    • Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)

    • As Built / As Configured (ABAC) documents

    • High Level and Detailed Design documents

    • Security documentation (SSPs, SSP Annexes, etc.)

  • Experience working with infrastructure and application teams

  • Exposure to:

    • Microsoft technologies

    • Cloud platforms (Azure preferred)

    • DevOps practices

    • Application development or Infrastructure as Code

Skills & Attributes
  • Exceptional technical writing and communication skills

  • Ability to translate complex technical information into clear, structured documentation

  • Strong collaboration and interpersonal skills

  • Ability to research, learn quickly, and work effectively with SMEs and external vendors

  • High attention to detail and strong assurance mindset

Why This Role Matters You will play a critical part in shaping how a major government cloud platform presents itself for IRAP assessment—strengthening its documentation, clarifying its security posture, and enabling a smooth assurance process.

If you’re an IRAP Assessor who enjoys combining technical depth with documentation excellence, this opportunity offers meaningful impact within a high value environment.

job.title: Network Infrastructure Architect
job.description:
Infrastructure Architect – Network & Security Design Canberra | Federal Government | Long-term Program

A major Federal program is seeking an experienced Infrastructure Architect to design, implement, and evolve complex ICT network environments across on-premises and cloud platforms. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in secure, high-assurance domains and can translate business needs into robust, scalable and compliant technical solutions.

The role: You’ll play a key part in shaping the organisation’s network and infrastructure capability. Your work will span design, assurance, documentation and stakeholder engagement across multiple systems and environments.

What you’ll be doing
  • Designing and building ICT network infrastructure aligned to whole-of-government security and policy requirements

  • Facilitating workshops to capture business requirements and define improved network processes

  • Leading continuous improvement activities to ensure capacity, availability and operational resilience

  • Providing specialist technical advice to stakeholders and escalating complex issues where architectural input is required

  • Managing competing priorities within a team of specialists

  • Transferring knowledge to departmental staff and ensuring documentation meets recordkeeping standards

  • Producing high quality architectural deliverables including:

    • High-level designs and technical security documentation

    • Detailed designs and as-built documentation

    • SOPs, technical support artefacts and post incident inputs

    • Security authorisation and assurance documentation

Why this role matters: You’ll be central to delivering secure, resilient and scalable infrastructure for a mission-critical government environment. The work is complex, strategically important and offers the opportunity to influence long-term technology direction.

job.title: Principle Cyber Security Advisor
job.description:
NV1 Security Clearance Required

At e2 Cyber, we're partnering with a leading Defence organisation to find a Principal Cyber Security Advisor for a high-profile program based in Mawson Lakes.

This is an opportunity to join a complex engineering environment where you'll be responsible for driving security assurance, accreditation, and risk management activities across classified systems. Working closely with engineering, project, and customer stakeholders, you'll play a key role in ensuring security is embedded throughout the entire system life cycle.

As a trusted security advisor, you'll provide practical guidance and leadership across security assurance activities while helping programs navigate complex security and compliance requirements.

Key Responsibilities
  • Lead cyber security risk assessments, vulnerability assessments, and security assurance activities.
  • Develop accreditation packages, security documentation, and assurance artefacts.
  • Provide advice on security controls, system architecture, and secure design principles.
  • Support accreditation and authorisation outcomes within classified environments.
  • Identify security risks and work with stakeholders to implement effective mitigation strategies.
  • Collaborate with engineering, project, and customer teams to achieve security and compliance objectives.
  • Support security governance activities and compliance with Government security frameworks.
  • Contribute to the delivery of secure, resilient, and operationally effective systems.
About You
  • Experience within Cyber Security, System Security, Security Assurance, Accreditation, Governance, or Risk roles.
  • Strong understanding of security risk management and assurance frameworks.
  • Experience developing accreditation documentation and security artefacts.
  • Knowledge of Australian Government security requirements, including the ISM, PSPF, DSPF, and DISP.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills.
  • Previous experience working within Defence or other highly regulated environments.
Why Apply?
  • Work on a critical Defence capability program.
  • Join a collaborative team of security and engineering professionals.
  • Influence security outcomes across complex and highly classified systems.
  • Long-term contract opportunity with a competitive day rate.
  • Flexible hybrid working arrangements.
If you're looking for a role where you can genuinely influence security outcomes and work on some of Australia's most complex technology programs, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now or contact the team at e2 Cyber for a confidential discussion.
